claims.title: Explicit harmonic projectors and bounded integral quotient maps
claims.statement: Construct pi and every level projector by the sl2 commutator, prove the harmonic direct sum and actual quotient maps, and bound their Gauss-lattice denominator by ceil((m+2)(log_p(8a+m)+1)) using Legendre binomial valuations. Equivariance gives the same bound for every ordinary lattice.
